Text.Text: The expedition leader is defeated and the withdrawal route is open. The survivors can leave with their records. You gave them that chance. We can now finish your instruction in Last Stand of the Light.
I can only take someone who has mastered the Force discipline. Reach rank 50 before we discuss the work below.

Keep your voice down. A looting expedition has occupied the crypt depths and attacked the survey crews. Their rear guard is cutting off the withdrawal route. Defeat 6 Crypt Raider enemies in the outer rite chambers of the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. Recover the Last Stand of the Light Crypt Trial Tablet.
Take the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths Key. Defeat 6 Crypt Raider enemies in the outer rite chambers of the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. Recover the Last Stand of the Light Crypt Trial Tablet.
Last Stand of the Light means keeping others alive when retreat becomes difficult. Clearing an escape route is worth more than dying impressively in it.

The key opens the sealed entrance to the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. Start in the outer rite chambers. I am arranging passage for the wounded at the starport. The raiders move their stolen relics between several chambers; their records will tell us which routes remain open.
Armed relic thieves, led by a Force-trained expedition leader. They answer to their buyers, not the academy. They attacked the survey crews for refusing to hand over the tomb records.
Defeat 6 Crypt Raider enemies in the outer rite chambers of the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. Recover the Last Stand of the Light Crypt Trial Tablet.
You have the Last Stand of the Light Crypt Trial Tablet. Let me see it.
The tablet identifies the stolen relics. Their handlers have moved deeper into the galleries.

The outer guards were only the beginning. The raiders are concentrating stolen relics farther down. Defeat 5 Crypt Marauder enemies in the narrow galleries of the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. Recover the Last Stand of the Light Ritual Focus Shard.
Defeat 5 Crypt Marauder enemies in the narrow galleries of the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. Recover the Last Stand of the Light Ritual Focus Shard.
The Last Stand of the Light Ritual Focus Shard was taken from a sealed relic chamber. Recovering it denies the raiders a focus for their stolen techniques.
Continue from the outer chambers into the narrow galleries. They keep the shard near their supplies so they can defend both.
These fighters support each other. Interrupt the one using the relic while your companions keep the others occupied.
Defeat 5 Crypt Marauder enemies in the narrow galleries of the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. Recover the Last Stand of the Light Ritual Focus Shard.
You brought the Last Stand of the Light Ritual Focus Shard. Hand it over and we can finish this part.
The focus shard is secure. We can now work on the sealed gate.

The raiders have fortified the breach to protect their excavation. Defeat 1 Crypt Breach Captain in the deep tomb breach of the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. Recover the Last Stand of the Light Splintered Tomb Sigil. Bring at least two allies.
Defeat 1 Crypt Breach Captain in the deep tomb breach of the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. Recover the Last Stand of the Light Splintered Tomb Sigil. Bring at least two allies.
The Crypt Breach Captain is the expedition's enforcer at the breach. The raiders put their strongest fighter there to hold off the survey crews.
The sigil was broken off a sealed tomb entrance. It will identify which chamber they forced and what still needs to be secured.
Bring two allies. One opponent is easy to pin against that doorway; a coordinated group can split the pressure and carry an injured companion out.
Defeat 1 Crypt Breach Captain in the deep tomb breach of the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. Recover the Last Stand of the Light Splintered Tomb Sigil. Bring at least two allies.
You brought the Last Stand of the Light Splintered Tomb Sigil. Hand it over and we can finish this part.
The gate is clear. The sigil will let us identify the remaining control seals.

The breach is clear. Four senior raiders still control access to the sealed relic chambers. Defeat 4 Crypt Reaver enemies in the keeper chambers of the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. Recover the Last Stand of the Light Keeper's Rite Token.
Defeat 4 Crypt Reaver enemies in the keeper chambers of the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. Recover the Last Stand of the Light Keeper's Rite Token.
The four senior raiders control the expedition's access to the remaining relics. They are guarding stolen property and their own escape route.
The Last Stand of the Light Keeper's Rite Token was stolen from the tomb custodians. Recovering it will let the custodians secure the next seal.
Do not let all four focus on one fighter. Separate their positions and keep watch on the gallery behind you.
Defeat 4 Crypt Reaver enemies in the keeper chambers of the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. Recover the Last Stand of the Light Keeper's Rite Token.
You brought the Last Stand of the Light Keeper's Rite Token. Hand it over and we can finish this part.
The token is secure. There is one final chamber to clear.

Their leader is preparing the last shipment from the lowest chamber. Stop the expedition before it can regroup. Defeat 1 Crypt Expedition Leader in the lowest burial chamber of the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. Bring at least two allies.
Defeat 1 Crypt Expedition Leader in the lowest burial chamber of the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. Bring at least two allies.
The Crypt Expedition Leader is a living Force-trained relic thief. He controls the expedition from the deepest chamber. Break his hold there and the surviving crews can withdraw.
The stolen relics support the leader's technique. Watch the timing, cover one another, and interrupt the attacks that would cut off your retreat.

I am arranging passage for the wounded at the starport. The raiders move their stolen relics between several chambers; their records will tell us which routes remain open. When you return, the recovered records will let us account for what they stole.
Defeat 1 Crypt Expedition Leader in the lowest burial chamber of the Korriban Sith Crypt Depths. Bring at least two allies.
The Crypt Expedition Leader is down. Tell me what happened.

The expedition leader is defeated and the withdrawal route is open. The survivors can leave with their records. You gave them that chance. We can now finish your instruction in Last Stand of the Light.
Go over the first assignment.
I will clear the outer chambers.
What does this discipline teach?
Where do I go, and why are you staying here?
Who or what will I be fighting?
I need to prepare first.
Here is the recovered tablet.
Go over the next objective.
I will recover the focus shard.
Why does the shard matter?
Where do they keep it?
How do they fight?
I need more time.
Here is the focus shard.
Explain the gate assignment again.
I will bring two allies and clear the breach.
What guards the gate?
Why recover the broken sigil?
Why bring a group?
I will gather my companions first.
The gate is clear. Here is the sigil.
Go over the four targets again.
I will stop the four senior raiders.
Who are the four targets?
What does the token do?
How should we approach them?
I need to rest first.
Here is the recovered token.
Go over the final objective.
We will go in together.
What is waiting in the last chamber?
What makes the leader dangerous?
What happens after this?
My companions need to prepare.
The final target is down. We made it out.
